svg.title: Three extensions, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the three Lesson 3-4 extensions on a 4 by 4 taped grid. First a bigger square with SIDE = 3, from the bottom-left corner. Then a rectangle with sides of 2, 3, 2 and 3 intersections. Then a square driven with left turns, starting from the bottom-right corner and going round counterclockwise. Each one ends back on its start corner facing the way it began. Beside it, the loop for each run, with the line running highlighted.
svg.text: Each variation changes one thing: the
value of SIDE, a list of side lengths,
or which way the robot turns.

g.text: the same square, the other way round
